postload_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
postload_actions.text: That hair smells like... Led Zeppelin albums. I'll leave it here until I need it again.
postload_actions.cage: May I also suggest a haircut? Unless you're a 20 year old guitarist from Seattle.

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text: An elevator! Maybe I can use this to get out of here...!

default_actions.speaker: BAAL
default_actions.text: AS IF! THAT ELEVATOR'S ONLY GOING ONE WAY, CHUMP - AND IT'S NOWHERE, FAST!

default_actions.speaker: BAAL
default_actions.text: YEAH, IT'S BEEN OUT OF ORDER FOR AGES. UNLESS YOU'RE HIDING A TOOL BELT IN THAT NECKTIE OF YOURS, YOU'D BETTER FORGET ABOUT IT.

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text: I don't suppose I can just take the stairs?

default_actions.speaker: BAAL
default_actions.text: THE STAIRS ARE ALSO BROKEN. EVERYTHING BREAKS HERE. BECAUSE IT'S HELL! BOOGEDY-BOOGEDY!

default_actions.speaker: TONY
default_actions.text: Like I said - ain't no way I can crack those doors open 'til I get my lost item back.

default_actions.speaker: TONY
default_actions.text: 'Til then, well, I guess I'll make sure the floor outside the elevator is extra-clean.

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text: Freedom's one pry away... crowbar, time to do your stuff!

crowbar.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
crowbar.text: FINALLY! The elevator's open! Time to hightail it out of here!
crowbar.cage: Champagne would fall from the heavens. Doors would open. Velvet ropes would part.

crowbar.speaker: TONY
crowbar.text: ...you know, he could've given me my crowbar back before leaving.

crowbar.speaker: TONY
crowbar.text:
Or offered me a trip out of hell. Just sayin'. 
 Ah well. This ol' netherworld ain't gonna spitshine itself...

default_actions.speaker: CIRCLES OF OFFICE HELL
default_actions.text:
FLOOR 1 - Reception 
 FLOOR 2 - Procrastinators 
 FLOOR 3 - Breakroom Foodstealers

default_actions.speaker: CIRCLES OF OFFICE HELL
default_actions.text:
FLOOR 4 - Petty Thieves 
 FLOOR 5 - The Monday-Casers 
 FLOOR 6 - In-the-box Thinkers

default_actions.speaker: CIRCLES OF OFFICE HELL
default_actions.text:
FLOOR 7 - Buzzword Users 
 FLOOR 8 - Yes-Men 
 FLOOR 9 - Ink Cartridge Wasters

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text: ...Ball Hell isn't even on this list.
default_actions.cage: I didn't misspell ANYthing! Not ONCE, not ONE TIME!

default_actions.speaker: BAAL
default_actions.text: WE'RE RENTING OUT THE BASEMENT! PRETTY INDIE, RIGHT?

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text: Going up?
WHIIIIIR CHUNK, KA-THUNK!

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text: Hey, I just heard a noise! Maybe this elevator is still working?

default_actions.speaker: BAAL
default_actions.text: WHAT ARE YOU TALKING ABOUT, FOOL? THAT WAS JUST THE RETRO ELEVATOR-THEMED RINGTONE ON MY APPLE SMARTPOD. NO WORKING ELEVATORS HERE!

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text: I honestly don't see how I could get much lower.

default_actions.speaker: BAAL
default_actions.text: OOH, OUCH! KITTY'S GOT CLAWS!

default_actions.speaker: BAAL
default_actions.text: SWANKY DECOR, RIGHT? YEAH, I LIKE TO LAY SOME OPULENCE ON FOLKS WHEN THEY WALK THROUGH THE DOOR.

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text: Through what door? The elevator door? Is the elevator still working?
default_actions.cage: I have money, I have taste. But I'm not on anybody's A list, and Saturday night is the loneliest night for me.

default_actions.speaker: BAAL
default_actions.text: THROUGH THE DOOR I AM ABOUT TO PUNCH INTO YOUR FACE WITH MY OMNIPOTENT DEVIL-FISTS!

default_actions.speaker: BAAL
default_actions.text: YEAH, THAT'S NOT A PA SYSTEM. IT'S PROBABLY, LIKE, PART OF A SPIDER'S WEB. SPIDERS IN HELL ARE REALLY BIG ELECTRONICS GEEKS.

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text: Are you saying they're... Akihabarachnids?

default_actions.speaker: BAAL
default_actions.text: ...STOP IT. THAT SORT OF THING IS ONLY CLEVER WHEN I DO IT.

default_actions.speaker: BATHROOM DOOR
default_actions.text: You perv! This is a restroom for LADIES ONLY. Or did you miss the shapely demoness in silhouette on the door?

default_actions.speaker: BATHROOM DOOR
default_actions.text: Granted, your doughy face lacks pronounced masculine features... but with hair like that, there's no way you're a girl!

default_actions.speaker: BATHROOM DOOR
default_actions.text: Ohh, who is that pretty lady? You must be new here, madame!

default_actions.speaker: BATHROOM DOOR
default_actions.text: Please, allow me to welcome you to Ball Hell's sparkling Ladies Rest Facilities!

default_actions.speaker: BATHROOM DOOR
default_actions.text: No boys allowed!

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text: *sigh* How about now?
default_actions.cage: If you'll excuse me, I have to use the... little boy's... wee wee room.

default_actions.speaker: BATHROOM DOOR
default_actions.text: What the...? I could have sworn you were a pudgy middle-aged marble just a moment ago! Please enter, dear.

default_actions.speaker: TONY
default_actions.text: The elevator's up and running again! You can jet back up to the living world as you please.

default_actions.speaker: TONY
default_actions.text: ...yep, those are both things I'd like to have been able to say, if they were true.

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text: Y-you can't fix the elevator? But you're a janitor!
default_actions.cage: Alright, I'm a little TIRED... I'm a little WIRED... and I think, I deserve, a LITTLE appreciation!

default_actions.speaker: TONY
default_actions.text: Janitors ain't gods, kid. I know it's easy to forget that. We're only good as our tool belts.

default_actions.speaker: TONY
default_actions.text: Truth is, I used to own a tool that could break this seal. Before... the dark times...

default_actions.speaker: BAAL
default_actions.text: OOH, IS THIS GONNA BE A SECRET BACKSTORY? I LOVES ME SOME SECRET BACKSTORY.

default_actions.speaker: TONY
default_actions.text: I was out on a routine custodial call. Someone had stuffed a giant squid in the watercooler. Nothin' I hadn't dealt with before.

default_actions.speaker: TONY
default_actions.text: What I didn't realize was that earlier that day, a demon had escaped from a higher circle of Office Hell... one reserved for PETTY THIEVES.

default_actions.speaker: TONY
default_actions.text: I turned my head, and just like that - half my tool belt was gone. Including the only item that can open this elevator.

default_actions.speaker: TONY
default_actions.text: But it didn't stop there. Over the years, that Supply Thief plundered bagged lunches, whiteout... staples beyond counting.

default_actions.speaker: TONY
default_actions.text: Nobody's ever seen that thief's face. But we know they're still out there... blending silently into our ranks.

default_actions.speaker: BAAL
default_actions.text: MEH. AN EARNEST EFFORT, BUT FAILS TO DAZZLE. BAAL GIVES THIS BACKSTORY - A 7.3 OUT OF 10.

default_actions.speaker: TONY
default_actions.text: Hey. Kid. It probably won't do much good, but... I want you to take this letter with you.

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text:
'To: The Scandalous Supply-Snatchler'... 
 You wrote hate mail to the item thief?

default_actions.speaker: TONY
default_actions.text: Mostly as self-therapy. But hey, maybe you Pachinko Men rub shoulders with types we janitors don't.

default_actions.speaker: TONY
default_actions.text: If you can track down the thief, and show 'em that letter - maybe they'll be overcome by guilt and fork over my item.

default_actions.speaker: BAAL
default_actions.text: UH. YEAH. GOOD LUCK WITH THAT.

default_actions.speaker: TONY
default_actions.text: How goes the hunt, kid?

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text: Er... I'm not really sure where to start? There's a lot of ground to cover.

default_actions.speaker: BAAL
default_actions.text: A LOT OF... YOU'VE VISITED A TOTAL OF LIKE 10 ROOMS, YOU ENORMOUS INFANT.

default_actions.speaker: TONY
default_actions.text: Well, mebbe you just need a refresher course on the facts of the case, huh?

default_actions.speaker: TONY
default_actions.text: ...so just run with that, yeah? I'm not expecting miracles, here.

default_actions.speaker: TONY
default_actions.text: Hey, uh, still waitin' on that lost item. Not to be passive agressive about it or nothin'.

default_actions.speaker: TONY
default_actions.text: I'll be re-damned... it's my old crowbar! You haven't aged a day, old friend.

default_actions.speaker: TONY
default_actions.text: But, hey, that's more 'n enough jawin' from me. You and I had better get that elevator running again, eh?

default_actions.speaker: TONY
default_actions.text: Why don't you do the honors, kid? Seems appropriate. You're an honorary custodian for the day!

stapler.speaker: TONY
stapler.text: I'll polish your office supplies another time, kid. Bit busy at the moment.

scissors.speaker: TONY
scissors.text: I'll polish your office supplies another time, kid. Bit busy at the moment.

lens.speaker: TONY'S THOUGHTS
lens.text: I can weild this here mop 'til the cows come home, but as long as HE roams free... Ball Hell will never truly be clean...

hatemail.speaker: TONY
hatemail.text: So whatever happened to the Supply Thief, eh? Finally hauled off to meet justice, eh?

hatemail.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
hatemail.text: I can confirm that he was hauled off.

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text: This length of rope seems like it might come in handy. I'd better stash it in my inventory.

default_actions.speaker: BAAL
default_actions.text: Y'KNOW, YOU HAVE PRETTY DEEP POCKETS FOR A SPHERE WITH LIMBS.

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text: I hope Pinball Man won't mind that I'm taking a break from his 'do.
